# pve_apt_versions (Data Source)

Installed/available package versions on a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_apt_versions" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/apt/versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Package Architecture.
- `currentstate` (String) Current state of the package installed on the system.
- `description` (String) Package description.
- `managerversion` (String) Version of the currently running pve-manager API server.
- `notifystatus` (String) Version for which PVE has already sent an update notification for.
- `oldversion` (String) Old version currently installed.
- `origin` (String) Package origin, e.g., 'Proxmox' or 'Debian'.
- `package` (String) Package name.
- `priority` (String) Package priority.
- `runningkernel` (String) Kernel release, only for package 'proxmox-ve'.
- `section` (String) Package section.
- `title` (String) Package title.
- `version` (String) New version to be updated to.
